items.headline: CoreWeave stock pops 12% as revenue doubles on accelerating AI infrastructure demand
items.summary: CoreWeave's revenue is surging as the AI boom continues, but the company is also sitting on $35 billion in debt.

items.headline: Trump administration ends Medicaid, CHIP funding for gender-affirming care for children
items.summary: Federal dollars in the two health insurance programs would not go toward gender-affirming care, but states could still cover the treatments.

items.headline: Microsoft: Don't Get Too Excited (Rating Downgrade) (NASDAQ:MSFT)
items.summary: Microsoft Corporation stock analysis: cloud competition, Azure vs. AWS/Google, strong free cash flow, and valuation risks. Click for this MSFT update.

items.headline: GM reaches up to $4.5 billion parts deal designed to avoid supply chain troubles
items.summary: The deal follows years of global automotive supply chain issues for GM and other companies.

items.headline: Why Jensen Huang’s $500 billion AI financing plan faces a big risk from China
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is pitching GPUs as long-term collateral to unlock $500 billion in funding. The question is how fast will his chips depreciate?

items.headline: Dow Jones Futures: Stocks Pause Before CPI Inflation; 3 Nvidia Partners Lead Earnings Movers Late
items.summary: Dow Jones futures: The major market indexes fell ahead of CPI inflation data. Nvidia partners Lumentum, CoreWeave, Super Micro reported late.

items.headline: Quantinuum Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.summary: **media[1173333]**Second-Quarter Revenue Grew 279% Year-Over-Year; Increased FY2026 Outlook

items.headline: We're lifting our price target on Cardinal Health after issuing rosy profit guidance
items.summary: The quarter wasn't totally clean, but strong profitability matters the most.

items.headline: Longtime OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap leaves as shake-up at AI lab continues
items.summary: Longtime OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap announced his departure on Tuesday, the latest in a series of recent leadership shake-ups at the company.

items.headline: U.S. oil rises above $83 a barrel as Iran says Strait of Hormuz won't open until conditions are met
items.summary: U.S. oil had risen as much as 3% earlier in the day after President Donald Trump demanded that Iran pay reparations to the U.S.

items.headline: Riot Platforms strikes deal with Anthropic as bitcoin miners shift focus to AI infrastructure
items.summary: Bitcoin miner Riot Platform has struck a $9 billion, 20-year compute deal with Anthropic

items.headline: Why JPMorgan is investing big in the 2028 LA Olympics
items.summary: JPMorgan is making a nine-figure bet as the Olympics Games' first-ever global banking partner.

items.headline: An inflation report Wednesday should be a big deal for the Fed. Here's what to expect
items.summary: The consumer price index is expected to show only a modest increase for July.

items.headline: Trump says NYC pied-à-terre tax 'must be stopped,' eyes federal block
items.summary: Trump in a Truth Social post called Mamdani's pied-à-terre tax a "dangerous political 'experiment' in New York will destroy" the city and state.

items.headline: AI computing power is becoming a tradable asset class as CME launches futures contracts
items.summary: The exchange is partnering with Silicon Data to introduce two compute futures contracts on Oct. 5, pending regulatory review.

items.headline: Democrats clash again in Minnesota and Wisconsin primaries as big midterm races take shape
items.summary: In Minnesota, progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan and moderate Democratic Rep. Angie Craig are competing for the nomination to succeed the retiring Sen. Tina Smith.

items.headline: Invitation Homes CEO says ban on institutional homebuying will bring down prices, but not immediately
items.summary: The CEO of the nation's largest single-family rental landlord said the new law banning large-scale investors from the market will lower prices in the long term.

items.headline: Trump wants to split the MMR vaccine. Experts say that's unlikely — and comes with consequences
items.summary: Doctors and other experts say that splitting the measles, mumps and rubella shot has no scientific basis and is unlikely to get off the ground.

items.headline: Manus to return as independent company after China forced Meta to unwind $2 billion deal
items.summary: Last December, Meta said it planned to acquire Manus for $2 billion, its latest effort to shore up its AI strategy.

items.headline: Target appoints its first chief AI officer as big retailers bet on AI
items.summary: Target announced its first-ever chief artificial intelligence officer on Tuesday as retailers race to take advantage of the AI boom.
